definitions.supplemental: Cf. Icel. Hlið-skjálf; f. Odin's seat whence he looked out on all the world.

quotations.english: With lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make the ark, Gen. 6, 16

source_text: scilfe, an; f. A shelf, ledge, floor:?-Gescype scylfan on scipes bósme (cf. With lower, second, and third stories shalt thou make the ark, Gen. 6, 16), Cd. Th. 79, 4; Gen. 1306. [Cf. Icel. Hlið-skjálf; f. Odin?s seat whence he looked out on all the world.]
